comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Carillon (9-knob). Resonant filter bank: 32 band-pass filters C2..C8 snapped to a key and scale; Decay takes them from one filter to ringing bells. Key and Scale are named-step knobs (labels: build/selector_metadata.py); the rest are 0..100.
fxid_comment: 0x01A5. In this project's reserved 403-499 Delay block, after HorizonL 420. Was 497 until version 0.04: Matujuice's Looper (GRDLOOP) has Delay 497, so 497 is retired. Free in every collection in repeat98's FXID registry and in Matujuice's pack (checked 2026-11-20).

params.name: Cutoff
params.comment: params[5]. Where the bank's emphasis sits, C2 .. above C8.

params.name: Reso
params.comment: params[6]. Boost of the bands around Cutoff.

params.name: Decay
params.comment: params[7]. Band width and ring: 0 one plain filter, 100 bells ringing a few seconds.

params.name: Key
params.comment: params[8]. Named steps C .. B: the scale's root; in Free, moves the bank.

params.name: Scale
params.comment: params[9]. Named steps: Free, Chrom, Major, Minor, Dor, Pent, MinPt, Whole, Fifth, Oct.

params.name: Waves
params.comment: params[11]. 0..50 depth of a slow ripple across the bands; 50..100 full depth, faster.

params.name: Noise
params.comment: params[12]. 0..50 random bands struck on their own; 50..100 adds a hiss that makes the bank whistle.
